title: Paddle v2: Left initial cue — per-channel average PSD
caption: 25 complete recorded trials; 81 5-second epochs (56 complete, 25 partial). Each channel is analysed independently: PSD per epoch, mean epoch PSD within each trial, then equal trial mean in linear power. DPSS NW=1, K=1; 0.2 Hz FFT grid. Dotted blue/orange: 17/19 Hz. Same y limits for every channel and condition within this game. Groups use the initial cue; later Paddle v2 phases can change direction.
